_published_faq.name: How do I add Fospha (North & South America) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fospha (North & South America) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.us.fospha.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fospha (North & South America) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fospha (North & South America) lists 20 MCP tools, including forecast_beam, fospha_annotations, fospha_intro, get_annotations, get_attribution_comparison, get_beam_data, get_benchmarks, get_campaign_types, get_campaigns, get_channels, get_clients, and get_custom_categories.

_published_faq.name: Does Fospha (North & South America) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fospha (North & South America) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fospha (North & South America) is developed by Fospha Corporation. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
